title: First Enchantment
description: This ring is not a lesson piece. A Dalhurst merchant has already paid the Circle for a ring of minor protection, and the coin is spent whether or not the enchantment holds. The Circle's enchanter needs a second set of hands to gather what the ritual takes and see it through - your first real enchantment, on a deadline a paying customer is watching.

objectives.description: Learn what the paying customer's ring actually needs
Buy a silver ingot from a blacksmith - out of Circle funds, not the merchant's
objectives.notes: Can be purchased from blacksmith in Dalhurst or Thornfield

objectives.description: Collect enchanting dust before the ritual window closes
objectives.notes: Available from magic shops or dropped by magical creatures

objectives.description: Hold the ritual steady while the ring takes the enchantment
Tell Elara the customer's ring is finished and worth what he paid

notes: Threat: a botched or late enchantment on a ring already paid for. Giver motive: the Circle takes commissions from Dalhurst patrons to fund itself, and a failed job is money refunded and a customer who doesn't come back. Consequence: unstated on the page - the quest cannot fail, so the stakes named in the description are never actually spent. First Apprentice quest.
